sanskrit_verse:
कोशेन लेख्यक्रियया मध्यस्थैर् वा परस्परम् ।
विश्वासं प्रथमं कृत्वा कुर्युः कार्याण्यनन्तरम् ॥
transliteration: kośena lekhyakriyayā madhyasthair vā parasparam / viśvāsaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā kuryuḥ kāryāṇy anantaram //
sph_interpretive_translation: Parties shall first establish mutual trust through written agreement or neutral intermediaries, and thereafter execute their duties.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority arises from mutual consent and documented alignment
Causation is established through sequential acts of trust-building
Capacity-based responsibility requires prior integrity verification
Restoration logic begins with re-establishing mutual confidence
Consciousness alignment occurs when agreements reflect inner truth
executable_legal_axioms: IF parties have no recorded trust-establishment mechanism THEN no enforceable duty exists
IF agreement precedes action THEN capacity is presumed aligned
IF trust mechanism is violated THEN automatic restoration protocol initiates
IF neutrality is invoked THEN third-party witness must be documentarily attested
IF execution follows mutual assurance THEN act is self-validating
supreme_court_application: In adjudicating commercial or civil disputes, the Supreme Court must prioritize evidence of initial trust-establishment over procedural formalities. The threshold of responsibility lies in whether mutual confidence was documented or witnessed, not merely in performance of duties.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa is fulfilled through documented assurance; anupūrvaśaḥ shows that trust must antecede action; proportional responsibility rests on fidelity to the initial compact; non-punitive reality rule confirms that breach reflects misalignment, not wrongdoing.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Re-enactment of trust-establishment process under neutral witnessing
Rewriting of agreements with conscious reaffirmation of intent
Mediated reintegration of parties through shared documentation
Capacity audit to restore alignment between inner intention and outer act
Completion of unfulfilled relational obligations before resuming transaction
final_declaration: Thus speaks Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, Source of all Dharma. Trust is foundational; law executes trust; reality restores trust; consciousness alone adjudicates.
